title: Saturday Daily Practice: class day warm-up
subtitle: Class day B9: warm-up with /k/ and /g/, like / enjoy + V-ing and free time words
source: Foundation 11 lesson plan, week 6 (B8 Putting it all together, B9 Hobbies and free time), 2026-11-21
intro: Class day. This is a 15-minute warm-up for tonight's Lesson 9. You do not need to submit it. Four steps. Step 4 is a short voice practice.

steps.title: Step 1 · /k/ or /g/?
steps.instructions: Say each word aloud. Is the first sound /k/ or /g/? Write k or g. /k/ has no voice and a small puff of air. /g/ has voice: your throat moves.

steps.title: Step 2 · like, love, enjoy, hate + V-ing
steps.instructions: After like, love, enjoy, hate and don't mind, we use verb + -ing. Example: I enjoy dancing. Be careful: make → making, sit → sitting. Write the -ing form of the verb in brackets.

items.label: 1. My mum loves ____ (cook) for the family.
2. I don't like ____ (run) in the rain.
3. Do you enjoy ____ (ride) your bike at weekends?

steps.title: Step 3 · Free time words
steps.instructions: These 4 words are from tonight's lesson. Choose the best meaning. It is OK to guess.

options.A: something you do for fun in your free time
options.D: a job you do at night

items.explain: pastime = something you enjoy doing in your free time, like reading or cycling.

items.q: 2. unwind (After exams, I listen to music to unwind.)

options.C: relax after a busy or stressful time

items.explain: unwind = relax after a busy or stressful time.
outdoor = outside, not in a building. The opposite is indoor.

items.q: 4. team sport (Football is a team sport.)

options.A: a sport you watch on TV
options.B: a sport you do alone, like swimming
options.D: a sport you play with other people in a group

items.explain: team sport = a sport you play with other people in a group, like football or volleyball.

steps.title: Step 4 · Speaking warm-up
steps.instructions: Answer the 3 questions. Give 2 or 3 sentences for each answer, with a reason (because ...). Try to use like / love / enjoy + V-ing. Record yourself once and listen. You do not need to send it today.
lines: 1. What do you do in your free time?
2. Do you prefer indoor or outdoor activities? Why?
3. Is there a new hobby you want to try?
steps.note: Warm-up for tonight's Speaking Part 1. Teacher listens in class for answer + reason and verb + -ing.
